entities.name: Sadage
entities.description: A cleric of the Cabal who receives Needle's gift for the Scion of Darkness and kills her as a reward.

entities.name: Needle
entities.description: A Cabal agent who infiltrated New Argive and brings a soul-drinking black sword, dying by Sadage's spell as her reward.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon lord worshipped by the Cabal, who supplanted the god Kuberr and is Liliana's last demon.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer from Tolarian Academy who pilots a fish-shaped diving ship to raise the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Hadi
entities.description: Jhoira's assistant artificer, an older man from Jamuraa.

entities.name: Ziva
entities.description: A Vodalian merfolk hired to raise the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker wounded by Nicol Bolas on Amonkhet, who stays to help Liliana kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker born on Dominaria who seeks to kill her last demon, Belzenlok, and learns her brother Josu is a lich.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who leaves the group to become stronger.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who quits the group in anger at Liliana.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, once raised as a mindless undead, now a lich serving Belzenlok as commander of the Cabal's forces.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who did not appear at the meeting place.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who defeated the group on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who suggested the meeting place and warned against going to Amonkhet.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon Liliana's group killed on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: A god of the Cabal supplanted by Belzenlok.

entities.name: Lady Ana
entities.description: Liliana's mother, killed by the undead Josu.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A figure Liliana first met in the marsh, who may be stalking her across the planes.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A death cult worshipping Belzenlok whose Stronghold is in Urborg and which has spread across Dominaria.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: A church that came to aid Benalia and was routed by the Cabal.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A legendary ship whose wreck lies in a bay and which Jhoira is raising.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An Onakke artifact that lets Liliana kill demons but saps her strength.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane to which the planeswalkers retreat.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane devastated in the battle against Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Vess
entities.description: Liliana's birthplace, a ruined Benalish town in a marsh.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: The ruined family manor, magically preserved in the morass.

entities.name: Caligo Morass
entities.description: A forest turned to marsh by the Cabal's influence.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The location of the Cabal's Stronghold.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The Cabal's worship hall in Urborg.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: A place Needle infiltrated for the Cabal.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The institution where Hadi came to work.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: A place the locals fought to keep from the Cabal.

entities.name: The Void
entities.description: A fate invoked by Cabal servants.

events.summary: Needle presents a black soul-drinking sword to Sadage as a gift for the Scion of Darkness.
events.quote: I bring you a gift for the Scion of Darkness.

events.summary: Sadage insists the sword's legend be credited to Belzenlok rather than another planeswalker.
events.quote: It was Belzenlok! Belzenlok forged it.

events.summary: Sadage kills Needle with a spell as her reward.
events.quote: Slowly, Needle's skin peeled from her chest as the violet spell light gently pierced her heart.

events.summary: Sadage goes to present the black blade to Belzenlok.
events.quote: Sadage opened the doors to the worship hall, ready to present the black blade to his chosen master

events.summary: Jhoira and Hadi spot the wreck of the Weatherlight on the sea floor.
events.quote: the long spine half-buried in the muck and waterweeds was too straight for any natural formation

events.summary: Jhoira hires the Vodalian Ziva to raise the Weatherlight within a day for double pay.
events.quote: The price is doubled if you can bring it up within two days,

events.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
events.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

events.summary: Gideon, wounded in the shoulder, admits the battle against Bolas did not go to plan.
events.quote: The second thing Gideon noticed was the hole in his shoulder and its piercing pain.

events.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
events.quote: He's given up.

events.summary: Nissa accuses Liliana of running after killing her demon Razaketh and using the group to free herself.
events.quote: You got what you wanted and ran.

events.summary: Liliana admits her last demon, Belzenlok, is on Dominaria.
events.quote: Belzenlok is here.

events.summary: Liliana asks Nissa to rouse Yavimaya's treefolk against the Cabal's Stronghold while she uses the Chain Veil.
events.quote: And I can use the Chain Veil to kill him.

events.summary: Nissa refuses and walks away, declaring her watch over.
events.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

events.summary: Nissa planeswalks away.
events.quote: Nissa was already stepping out of the plane.

events.summary: Chandra announces she will leave to become stronger.
events.quote: I'm going too.

events.summary: Chandra planeswalks away in a rush of fire.
events.quote: Her form disappeared in a rush of fire as she walked from the plane.

events.summary: Gideon decides to stay and work with Liliana.
events.quote: I'm staying.

events.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the town is her birthplace.
events.quote: It's where I was born.

events.summary: At the inn, Liliana tends Gideon's wound while the innkeeper says the Cabal has taken over the region.
events.quote: It's the Cabal,

events.summary: The innkeeper says the Church of Serra was routed by the Cabal in a battle days earlier.
events.quote: The Church of Serra came to help and there was a great battle only a few days ago, but the Cabal routed us.

events.summary: Liliana asks a girl if anyone remembers the House of Vess.
events.quote: Does anyone here remember the House of Vess?

events.summary: Gathering herbs, Liliana remembers meeting the Raven Man in the marsh.
events.quote: This was where she had first met the Raven Man.

events.summary: Liliana recalls how her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before she fled as her spark ignited (flashback).
events.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster that killed Lady Ana, killed her servants

events.summary: Liliana finds Vess Manor still standing.
events.quote: The house was still here.

events.summary: Liliana finds charred necromantic symbols and blood, convincing her it was no coincidence.
events.quote: Whatever had happened here, it was no coincidence.

events.summary: Cabal undead knights attack the town at nightfall.
events.quote: She had barely started on the path through the ruins when she sensed the surge of undead malice.

events.summary: Liliana destroys a dozen knights with necromantic bolts.
events.quote: As the etchings on her skin flared violet, bolts shot out from her hands to strike a dozen black-armored knights.

events.summary: Liliana seizes an undead knight and saves Gideon.
events.quote: In the next instant, he was hers.

events.summary: Tracing the knight's connection, Liliana sees the lich's face is Josu's.
events.quote: An image of the lich's face burned before her. The face was Josu's.

events.summary: A captured cleric reveals Belzenlok made Josu his servant and commander of his forces.
events.quote: He has made your precious brother into his servant, the commander of his unholy forces!

events.summary: The cleric dies after saying the Void awaits.
events.quote: and slumped lifeless on the pavement.

events.summary: Liliana vows to free Josu and make Belzenlok pay.
events.quote: You'll pay for this, Belzenlok,

relations.quote: ready to present the black blade to his chosen master

relations.quote: He has made your precious brother into his servant

relations.note: Her attempt to heal him raised him as an undead.
relations.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster

relations.note: Liliana and the group killed the demon Razaketh on Amonkhet.
Her last demon, whom she vows to destroy.
They stay together to destroy Belzenlok and then Bolas.
relations.quote: You need me to kill Belzenlok.
